title: Comparing Socially-Equitable Renewable Energy Budget Allocation MDP Policies in Mature and Emerging Economies
abstract: arXiv:2607.10201v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Equitable renewable-energy planning is a sequential decision problem, but the decision variables available to a public planner differ sharply between mature and emerging economies. In the former the government largely builds generation, while in the latter it steers private investment through incentives and quotas. We formulate socially-equitable renewable-energy budget allocation as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and, using a single problem-agnostic solver interface, compare the same policies across the two settings: eight U.S. cities (a mature economy) and West Java, Indonesia (an emerging economy). The results show that across both settings, a receding-horizon value-iteration policy dominates. In the U.S., it reaches 66% renewable penetration while cutting the underserved low-income population by 96% versus a random baseline. translated_title: 比较成熟经济体与新兴经济体中社会公平的可再生能源预算分配MDP策略
translated_abstract: 公平的可再生能源规划本质上是一个序贯决策问题，但公共规划者可用的决策变量在成熟经济体和新兴经济体之间存在显著差异。在成熟经济体中，政府主要负责建设发电设施；而在新兴经济体中，政府通过激励措施和配额来引导私人投资。我们将社会公平的可再生能源预算分配问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并使用单一的问题无关求解器接口，在两种环境中比较相同的策略：美国八个城市（成熟经济体）和印度尼西亚西爪哇省（新兴经济体）。结果表明，在这两种环境中，滚动时域值迭代策略均占主导地位。在美国，该策略实现了66%的可再生能源渗透率，与随机基线相比，将服务不足的低收入人口减少了96%。在西爪哇，该策略在弥合电力接入差距的同时，撬动了约七倍的私人资本。
tldr: 该研究将社会公平的可再生能源预算分配建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），发现滚动时域值迭代策略在成熟经济体（美国城市，实现66%可再生能源渗透率并减少96%服务不足低收入人口）和新兴经济体（印尼西爪哇，撬动约七倍私人资本）中均表现最优。
en_tdlr: Formulating socially-equitable renewable energy budget allocation as an MDP, the study shows that a receding-horizon value-iteration policy dominates in both mature economies (U.S. cities, achieving 66% renewable penetration with 96% fewer underserved low-income people) and emerging economies (West Java, Indonesia, crowding in about seven times more private capital).
